name: Helvault
description: The Helvault is a silver monolith that Sorin created as half of Innistrad's protection, and which came to serve as a prison for demons, horrors and the angel Avacyn.

description_citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

summary.text: The Helvault is a silver monolith that Sorin created as half of Innistrad's protection, and which came to serve as a prison for demons, horrors and the angel Avacyn.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.

bio.text: Sorin found the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault and explained that it was half of what he had created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.

citations.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.
"Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

bio.text: Avacyn was imprisoned within it, and a sword forged from its silver, Eost, was later given to Dovid.

citations.text: "I Am Avacyn" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 May 2016.
"The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

bio.text: When Nahiri arrived on Innistrad she found the Helvault instead of Sorin, who bound her with moonlight and hurled her into it, where it absorbed her.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: Inside, Nahiri could not planeswalk, and the Helvault was slowly populated by demons and horrors.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

bio.text: The Helvault later cracked and shattered, freeing Nahiri and the angel, and Liliana recalled that she had broken it open and slain the demon Griselbrand.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

status.text: The Helvault has been broken open and shattered, and Olivia says whoever opened it released more than the archangel.

citations.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.
"Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Avacyn tasks Vronos with finding the cursed planeswalker Garruk and bringing him to her cathedral.
timeline.quote: You must find this man, Garruk, and bring him to my cathedral.

citation.text: "The Hunter Cannot Pity" by Jennifer Clarke Wilkes. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 16 Jul 2014.

timeline.summary: Dovid becomes Comitant Dovid, isolated from the cathars and church officials, carrying the first sword forged from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: That is how I became Comitant Dovid.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Dovid is given Eost, a sword forged from the Helvault, with his name at the top of the honored list.
timeline.quote: I have drawn it only once, during the ceremony where it was presented to me, when Avacyn touched its point.

citation.text: "The Lunarch's Journal" by Colin Kawakami. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Aug 2014.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin finds the lithomancer Nahiri beside the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Sorin knew her immediately.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Flashback: Sorin explains the Helvault is half of what he created to protect Innistrad, perhaps blocking her signal.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such protection.

citation.text: "Promises Old and New" by Ari Levitch. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 13 Apr 2016.

timeline.summary: Thalia confides her doubt that Avacyn was corrupted by her time in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: What if her time in the Helvault corrupted her?

citation.text: "The Lunarch Inquisition" by James Wyatt. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 May 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri arrives on a bluff on Innistrad and finds the Helvault instead of Sorin.
timeline.quote: On the highest part of the bluff, where she had sensed his presence, stood instead a massive, rough-hewn chunk of silver

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin reveals the Helvault may have blocked Nahiri's signal and shows no concern.
timeline.quote: This Helvault is half of what I created to serve as such a protection.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin binds Nahiri with a beam of moonlight, and she realizes the moon is made of silver like the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It was made of silver. Like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Sorin disarms Nahiri, puts his sword to her throat, then hurls her into the Helvault, which absorbs her.
timeline.quote: Then the Helvault claimed her, and she vanished into a darkness vast and total.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Inside the Helvault, Nahiri falls through darkness, unable to planeswalk.
timeline.quote: She tried to planeswalk, but even the Blind Eternities, the chaotic no-place between planes, was beyond her reach.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Nahiri holds on to sanity by building a mental model of Zendikar.
timeline.quote: Her memories of Zendikar became her lantern in the dark.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The Helvault is slowly populated by demons and horrors, and Nahiri understands its purpose.
timeline.quote: Slowly, over countless years, the Helvault was populated.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The angel enters the Helvault to fight the demons and Nahiri realizes Sorin made her.
timeline.quote: He had made her. Just like the Helvault.

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: The void cracks and the Helvault shatters, freeing Nahiri and the angel.
timeline.quote: And then there was light, real light, as the void around them cracked and shredded and finally...

citation.text: "Stone and Blood" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Olivia says whoever opened the Helvault released more than the archangel, including another being now angry.
timeline.quote: set loose more than just the archangel

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Liliana privately recalls that she broke the Helvault open and slew the demon Griselbrand.
timeline.quote: She had slain the demon Griselbrand

citation.text: "Innistrad's Last Hope" by Doug Beyer. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Jun 2016.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand challenges Avacyn at the Helvault; she drives him in but he impales her and she is imprisoned too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Disappearance of Balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess forces Thalia to open the Helvault, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: This resulted in the release of both the demons and Avacyn

citation.text: "Avacyn", section "Return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn, Griselbrand and numerous other demons are released from the Helvault.
timeline.quote: has been released from her prisoning, the Helvault .

citation.text: "Avacyn Restored", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault, freeing Avacyn.
timeline.quote: She forced the cathar Thalia to destroy the silver Helvault , where Avacyn was held, to reach one of her enemies .

citation.text: "Church of Avacyn", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Innistrad is overrun by creatures of the night while humans near extinction; Avacyn is revealed to be locked in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: It is revealed that Avacyn , the guardian angel created by Sorin is locked in the Helvault .

citation.text: "Dark Ascension", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin fashioned the Helvault from a chunk of the silver moon using lithomancy learned from Nahiri.
timeline.quote: Sorin fashioned it from a chunk of the plane's silver moon .

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Creation of Avacyn and the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Avacyn and her angels drew malevolent beings, including Nahiri, into the Helvault.
timeline.quote: the Helvault also contained Nahiri

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand landed on the Helvault under a full moon and challenged Avacyn.
timeline.quote: he landed on the Helvault itself, under a full moon, and challenged Avacyn to combat.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After days of battle Avacyn drove Griselbrand into the Helvault; he impaled her heart with his spear and she was drawn in too.
timeline.quote: Avacyn was drawn into the Helvault herself.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "The Helvault imprisonment". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana Vess threatened Thalia, leading to the sundering of the Helvault and the release of Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both Avacyn and the demons were unleashed back into the world.

citation.text: "Helvault", section "Destruction". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand traps Avacyn in the Helvault with him, weakening the rites that invoked her and humanity's defenses.
timeline.quote: First the demon Griselbrand trapped Avacyn in the Helvault with him

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: With zombie armies marching on Thraben, the Helvault is sundered and Avacyn is released.
timeline.quote: the Helvault was sundered and Avacyn was released.

citation.text: "Innistrad". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Sorin forges the angel Avacyn to protect humanity from the vampires, along with the Helvault, and is reviled as a traitor by most vampires.
timeline.quote: Sorin forged a warrior who could hold back the vampires and other threats

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Creation of Avacyn". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After Nahiri confronts him over the lost Zendikar signal, Sorin banishes her into the Helvault following a clash with Avacyn.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Griselbrand fights Avacyn for days; she drives him into the Helvault but is impaled by his spear and trapped inside alongside the demons.
timeline.quote: Avacyn became imprisoned in the Helvault alongside every other demon that had been trapped within

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Disappearance of balance". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault during the siege of Thraben, releasing the demons and Avacyn.
timeline.quote: With the sundering of the Helvault , both the demons and Avacyn were released

citation.text: "Innistrad (plane)", section "Avacyn's return". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Thalia chooses to save her men, causing the Sundering of the Helvault.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her men, allowing the Sundering of the Helvault to take place.

citation.text: "Liliana Vess", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana raises Mikaeus as a zombie, forces him to reveal the Helvault's secrets, then goes to perform the Sundering.
timeline.quote: Liliana raised Mikaeus as a zombie

citation.text: "Mikaeus Cecani", section "The Unhallowed". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri confronts Sorin on Innistrad, threatens him, fights Avacyn and is imprisoned by Sorin in the Helvault.
timeline.quote: The two fought until Sorin ended the battle by imprisoning Nahiri in the Helvault.

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Imprisoned on Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With the Helvault sundered, Nahiri returns to a ravaged Zendikar and swears vengeance on Sorin.
timeline.quote: she swore vengeance against Sorin

citation.text: "Nahiri", section "Revenge". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Nahiri threatens Sorin after he admits her call for help was absorbed by the Helvault; he banishes her into it.
timeline.quote: Sorin called the battle off and banished Nahiri into the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sorin Markov", section "Imprisoning Nahiri". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates the Helvault so Avacyn can seal away threats; she battles demons such as Ormendahl for about a thousand years.
timeline.quote: and sealing them within the Helvault

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In 4557 AR Griselbrand tricks Avacyn into banishing him into the Helvault and pulls her in, sealing them both.
timeline.quote: sealing them both inside

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana coerces Thalia into letting her shatter the Helvault, and it bursts apart, freeing everything inside.
timeline.quote: Thalia chose to save her people and allow Liliana to break open the Helvault.

citation.text: "Sundering of the Helvault", section "Sundering". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana forces Thalia to destroy the Helvault by threatening her soldiers, unleashing Avacyn and the demons.
timeline.quote: she forced Thalia to do so by threatening the lives of her soldiers

citation.text: "Thalia", section "The Sundering of the Helvault". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: In the Echoverse, Thalia finds that Avacyn imprisoned her angelic sisters in the Helvault and her faith shatters.
timeline.quote: when she discovered that Avacyn had imprisoned her angelic sisters inside, her unbreakable faith finally shattered

citation.text: "Thalia", section "Echoverse". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana causes the Sundering of the Helvault, freeing Avacyn, who casts the Cursemute and creates the Wolfir.
timeline.quote: Liliana caused the Sundering of the Helvault , and Avacyn was free.

citation.text: "Thraben", section "Siege of Thraben". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sorin creates Avacyn and the Helvault and imprisons Nahiri inside it.
timeline.quote: Sorin Markov creates Avacyn and the Helvault .

citation.text: "Timeline", section "War with Phyrexia (3285 AR to 4206 AR) [ 17 ]". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Liliana tracks Griselbrand to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.
timeline.quote: Liliana tracks Griselbrand 's disappearance to the Helvault and manipulates Thalia into destroying it.

citation.text: "Timeline", section "The Mending Era (4500 AR to 4562 AR)". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: After being released from the Helvault, Avacyn casts the cursemute, letting werewolves choose to fuse their human and wolf spirits into a permanent wolf form.
timeline.quote: After Avacyn was released from the Helvault , she cast a spell that granted the werewolves a choice to either remain a werewolf

citation.text: "Wolf", section "Innistrad". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
